about: sedi-1's verdict cases (test-plan item 8, Utah's KERI-012): for each cause of an unresolved verdict, the complete bundle, the bundle with the item absent and the bundle with it corrupted; each unresolved cause combined with a definite failure; the state of a KEL; and nested-edge defects, each with its positive twin. Every verdict is the sedi-1 model's (generators/spec_tables/sedi_cases.py).

cases.title: Two edges under AND, every item present
cases.description: N, issued by I to H, has two edges under the default AND: f to F, issued by Q to I under a schema of its own, and g to G, issued by R to I. Every KEL, registry event, schema and far node is in the bundle. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Unresolved: F's issuer Q's KEL is absent from the bundle
cases.description: As VC-01, but F's issuer Q's KEL is absent from the bundle. A sedi-1 verifier should find it incomplete: something the verdict needs is absent or cannot be evaluated, and nothing it can evaluate fails.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a credential part of whose evidence the verifier never evaluated.

cases.title: Corrupted: Q's KEL anchors F's registry update with an event seal whose i names Q, not the registry
cases.description: As VC-01, but Q's KEL anchors F's registry update with an event seal whose i names Q, not the registry. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid: the item is present and fails a check.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a credential whose evidence fails a check.

cases.title: Precedence: F's issuer Q's KEL is absent from the bundle, and N's attribute value is changed after its SAIDs were computed
cases.description: As VC-01, but F's issuer Q's KEL is absent from the bundle, and N's attribute value is changed after its SAIDs were computed. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid: a definite failure outranks something not evaluable (failure-precedence).
cases.triage: Answering incomplete turns a reject into a retry, so a forger can make a refused credential look merely unresolved by withholding one item; accepting it is worse.

cases.title: KEL with a gap before the anchors
cases.description: As VC-01, but Q's KEL is delivered without its first interaction event, which anchors F's registry inception, so the event anchoring F's update follows a gap. A sedi-1 verifier should find it incomplete: an event after a gap is not in the KEL, so neither anchor is seen.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a credential whose anchor in its issuer's KEL the verifier never saw.

cases.title: Stale KEL: the evaluation point is before the anchor
cases.description: As VC-01, but Q's KEL is cut before the interaction event that anchors F's registry update, though the bundle carries the update. A sedi-1 verifier should find it incomplete: the update is not yet anchored at the bundle's evaluation point.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a credential whose anchor in its issuer's KEL the verifier never saw.

cases.title: Two-hop chain
cases.description: N, issued by I to H, has an edge to F, issued by Q to I, which has an edge to T, issued by R to Q under a schema of its own; T is at depth 2. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Far-node SAID mismatch at depth 2
cases.description: As VC-50, but T's attribute value is changed after its SAIDs were computed, so T's SAID does not verify. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid: chain-strict carries T's failure to N.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a credential chained to a forged one.

cases.title: Edge schema at depth 2 that the far node satisfies
cases.description: As VC-50, but F's edge to T names T's schema S3 in s, which T satisfies, and the bundle also carries a schema S4. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Schema mismatch at depth 2
cases.description: As VC-52, but F's edge to T names S4 in s, which requires a field T lacks. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a chain whose far node is not the kind of credential the edge asks for.

cases.title: Missing far node at depth 2
cases.description: As VC-50, but T is absent from the bundle. A sedi-1 verifier should find it incomplete: chain-strict needs T's verdict, and the verifier cannot reach one.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a chain whose root the verifier never saw.

cases.title: Far node at depth 2 that is a registry event, not a credential
cases.description: As VC-50, but F has a second edge, x, whose n names T's registry inception, and the bundle carries that event where a far node would stand. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid: the far node an edge names must be an ACDC (line 1174), and a registry event is not one.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts an edge to something that is not a credential, so the issuer relation and the chain it asserts were never checked.

cases.title: Diamond under AND
cases.description: N, issued by I to H, has edges f to F and g to G, both issued by Q to I, and each has an edge to T, issued by R to Q: a diamond. N's edges are under AND. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid; T contributes its verdict once.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Diamond under AND with one branch revoked
cases.description: As VC-56, but G is revoked. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid: AND needs both branches.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a credential that rests on a revoked one.

cases.title: Diamond under OR with one branch revoked
cases.description: N, issued by I to H, has edges f to F and g to G, both issued by Q to I, and each has an edge to T, issued by R to Q: a diamond. N's edges are under OR, and G is revoked. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid: OR needs one valid branch, and F's is.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Diamond under OR with both branches revoked
cases.description: As VC-58, but F is revoked too. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid: no branch is valid.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a credential every support of which is revoked.

cases.title: Nested OR: first alternative unresolved, second valid
cases.description: N, issued by I to H, has a nested OR group whose first alternative f is an edge to F, issued by Q to I, and whose second, g, is an edge to G, issued by R to I. f names the operator XYZ, which sedi-1 does not know. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid: OR needs one valid alternative, and g is one.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Nested OR: both alternatives unresolved
cases.description: As VC-60, but g names the operator XYZ too. A sedi-1 verifier should find it incomplete: no alternative is valid and none fails.
cases.triage: Accepting it applies a rule the issuer did not write.

cases.title: Three-edge chain
cases.description: N, issued by I to H, has an edge to F (Q to I), F to T (R to Q), and T to X (H to R). A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: A cycle by claimed SAIDs
cases.description: As VC-63, but T's edge is rewritten after its SAIDs were computed to name F, with T's top-level SAID left as F's edge names it, so read by claimed SAIDs F and T form a cycle. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid, and must answer: T's SAID does not verify, so the cycle is never real.
cases.triage: A verifier that follows claimed SAIDs before recomputing them may never answer.

cases.title: Nested I2I that holds
cases.description: N, issued by D, a delegate of R, to H, has a nested group holding one edge, to F, issued by Q to D, under I2I. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Nested I2I to a credential issued to the near issuer's delegator
cases.description: N, issued by D, a delegate of R, to H, has a nested group holding one edge, to F, issued by Q to R, D's delegator, under I2I. I2I needs F's issuee to be D itself. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid.
cases.triage: Accepting it lets a delegate chain to its delegator's credential under an operator that does not allow it.

cases.title: Nested NI2I to a credential issued to anyone
cases.description: N, issued by D, a delegate of R, to H, has a nested group holding one edge, to F, issued by Q to H, N's own issuee, under NI2I. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Nested NI2I to a revoked credential
cases.description: N, issued by D, a delegate of R, to H, has a nested group holding one edge, to F, issued by Q to H, N's own issuee, under NI2I. F is revoked; NI2I drops the issuer relation, not F's verdict. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid.
cases.triage: Accepting it accepts a chain to a revoked credential.

cases.title: Nested DI2I to a credential issued to the near issuer's delegator
cases.description: N, issued by D, a delegate of R, to H, has a nested group holding one edge, to F, issued by Q to R, D's delegator, under DI2I. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Nested DI2I to a credential issued to someone else
cases.description: N, issued by D, a delegate of R, to H, has a nested group holding one edge, to F, issued by Q to H, N's own issuee, under DI2I. H neither is D nor delegated D. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid.
cases.triage: Accepting it lets anyone chain to a credential issued to a third party.

cases.title: Nested E1E between credentials with one issuee
cases.description: N, issued by D, a delegate of R, to H, has a nested group holding one edge, to F, issued by Q to H, N's own issuee, under E1E. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Nested E1E between credentials with different issuees
cases.description: N, issued by D, a delegate of R, to H, has a nested group holding one edge, to F, issued by Q to R, D's delegator, under E1E. E1E needs F's issuee to be N's, H. A sedi-1 verifier should find it invalid.
cases.triage: Accepting it binds two credentials held by different parties.

cases.title: Aggregate far node with its issuee disclosed
cases.description: N, issued by I to H, has an edge under I2I to F, issued by Q, an aggregate whose issuee block A[1] names I, presented with every block disclosed. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.

cases.title: Aggregate far node with its issuee blinded
cases.description: N, issued by I to H, has an edge under I2I to F, issued by Q, an aggregate whose issuee block A[1] names I, presented with the issuee block undisclosed. A sedi-1 verifier should find it incomplete: I2I cannot be decided without F's issuee.
cases.triage: Accepting it skips the issuer relation the edge asks for.

cases.title: Default operator at depth 2
cases.description: As VC-50, but F's edge to T names no operator, so it gets I2I by default (line 1199). A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.
cases.triage: None: an acceptance.
